description: Build the original Python CE ParserDefinition and PyParser for browser-side Python syntax diagnostics in WebAssembly GC.
notes: This probe runs the original Python CE parser in WebAssembly GC and emits parser error-node offsets for editor highlighting; it does not claim full PSI inspections.
The probe uses the original PythonParserDefinition, PyParser, PyElementTypesFacadeImpl, MockApplication, and real Python dialect token-set contributors.
It registers only the extension point currently required by lexer initialization. Further platform extension points or services may be required as initialization progresses.
Do not add handwritten syntax parsing or fake IntelliJ services to make this profile pass.
Keep the matching IntelliJ platform and Python CE artifacts at the same build version.
